title: MongoDB needs no table: the first write creates the collection, and createTable is refused
proves: a MongoDB project has no createTable and no DDL step: the first write creates the collection dm_s54_lines
the clear step makes a second run give the same 5 documents
createTable on a MongoDB target is refused with I929: MongoDB has no table to create
this project needs the MongoDB service: it runs in the external-service test job
